description_en: Creates a custom security policy for a TCP/SSL listener
description_zh: 在指定地域创建TCPSSL监听的自定义安全策略
kebab_example: aliyun nlb create-security-policy --tls-versions TLSv1.0 --ciphers ECDHE-ECDSA-AES128-SHA --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateSecurityPolicy

parameters.help_en: The Transport Layer Security (TLS) versions supported by the security policy. Valid values: TLSv1.0, TLSv1.1, TLSv1.2, and TLSv1.3
parameters.name: tls_versions

parameters.help_en:
The name of the security policy.

It must be 1 to 200 characters in length, and can contain letters, digits, periods (.), underscores (_), and hyphens (-)
parameters.help_zh:
安全策略名称。

长度为1~200个字符，支持中文和大小写英文字母，可包含数字、半角句号（.）、下划线（_）和短划线（-）
parameters.name: security_policy_name

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group to which the security policy belongs
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The cipher suites supported by the security policy. Valid values of this parameter vary based on the value of TlsVersions. You can specify up to 32 cipher suites.

TLSv1.0 and TLSv1.1 support the following cipher suites:

ECDHE-ECDSA-AES128-SHA
ECDHE-ECDSA-AES256-SHA
ECDHE-RSA-AES128-SHA
ECDHE-RSA-AES256-SHA
AES128-SHA
AES256-SHA
DES-CBC3-SHA

TLSv1.2 supports the following cipher suites:

ECDHE-ECDSA-AES128-SHA
ECDHE-ECDSA-AES256-SHA
ECDHE-RSA-AES128-SHA
ECDHE-RSA-AES256-SHA
AES128-SHA
AES256-SHA
DES-CBC3-SHA
ECDHE-ECDSA-AES128-GCM-SHA256
ECDHE-ECDSA-AES256-GCM-SHA384
ECDHE-ECDSA-AES128-SHA256
ECDHE-ECDSA-AES256-SHA384
ECDHE-RSA-AES128-GCM-SHA256
ECDHE-RSA-AES256-GCM-SHA384
ECDHE-RSA-AES128-SHA256
ECDHE-RSA-AES256-SHA384
AES128-GCM-SHA256
AES256-GCM-SHA384
AES128-SHA256
AES256-SHA256

TLSv1.3 supports the following cipher suites:

TLS_AES_128_GCM_SHA256
TLS_AES_256_GCM_SHA384
TLS_CHACHA20_POLY1305_SHA256
TLS_AES_128_CCM_SHA256
TLS_AES_128_CCM_8_SHA256

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform a dry run. Valid values:

true: validates the request without performing the operation. The system checks the request for potential issues, including missing parameter values, incorrect request syntax, and service limits. If the request fails the validation, the corresponding error message is returned. If the request passes the validation, the `DryRunOperation` error code is returned.
false (default): validates the request and performs the operation. If the request passes the validation, a 2xx HTTP status code is returned and the operation is performed
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求。取值：
true：发送检查请求，不会创建自定义安全策略。检查项包括是否填写了必需参数、请求格式、业务限制。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误。如果检查通过，则返回错误码`DryRunOperation`。
false（默认值）：发送正常请求，通过检查后返回HTTP 2xx状态码并直接进行操作
parameters.name: dry_run

parameters.help_en:
The client token used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the token. Ensure that the token is unique among different requests. Only ASCII characters are allowed.

If you do not set this parameter, the value of RequestId is used.**** The value of RequestId is different for each request
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId不一样
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the region where the NLB instance is deployed.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/443657.html operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh:
网络型负载均衡实例所在的地域ID。 

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/443657.html接口获取地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

fields.help_en:
The key of the tag. It must be 1 to 64 characters in length, cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`, and cannot contain `http://` or `https://`. It can contain letters, digits, underscores (_), periods (.), colons (:), forward slashes (/), equal signs (=), plus signs (+), minus signs (-), and at signs (@).

You can add up to 20 tags for the security policy in each call
fields.help_zh:
标签键。最多支持64个字符，不能以`aliyun`或`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或`https://`。支持字符包括字母、数字、下划线 (_)、点 (.)、冒号 (:)、斜线 (/)、等号 (=)、加号 (+)、减号 (-)、@符号 (@) 。

一次调用最多支持添加20个标签
fields.name: key

fields.help_en:
The value of the tag. It must be 1 to 128 characters in length, cannot start with `acs:` or `aliyun`, and cannot contain `http://` or `https://`. It can contain letters, digits, underscores (_), periods (.), colons (:), forward slashes (/), equal signs (=), plus signs (+), minus signs (-), and at signs (@).

You can add up to 20 tags for the security policy in each call
fields.help_zh:
标签值。最多支持128个字符，不能以`aliyun`或`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或`https://`。支持字符包括字母、数字、下划线 (_)、点 (.)、冒号 (:)、斜线 (/)、等号 (=)、加号 (+)、减号 (-)、@符号 (@) 。

一次调用最多支持添加20个标签
